result.topic_en: Notes dated Nov. 6 on the instrumental errors of Reichenbach's small theodolite (altitude reading as a function of the index setting A), followed by a geodetic problem of locating point 3 from known points 0, 1, 2 and a known azimuth 0–3 when directions from 3 need an orientation correction x.
result.transcription:
29
Nov. 6
Reichenbachs kleiner Theodolith
Kreis links Ind. I = A
Höhe $119^\circ 52' 49'' + 5''2 \cos A - 7''3 \sin A$
$= 119.52.49 + 9''0 \cos(A + 54^\circ 37')$

Geodät. Aufgabe
[figure: quadrilateral with points 0, 1, 2, 3; side 1–3 labelled r; diagonal 3–0; marginal label $R^{13}$]

Bekannt Lage von 0, 1, 2, Azimuth 0,3 dagegen
31 und 32 nicht orientirt sondern der
Correction x bedürftig

$R^{13} = r = \frac{R^{12} \sin(32 - 12 + x)}{\sin(31 - 32)} = \frac{R^{01} \sin(03 - 01)}{\sin(31 + x - 30)}$

methods.what: Altitude reading of the theodolite expressed as a periodic (eccentricity/graduation) error in the index setting A, combining cosine and sine terms into a single cosine with phase
Law of sines applied in triangles 1-2-3 and 0-1-3 to express distance r = R^{13} in two ways, giving an equation for the orientation correction x of unoriented directions
